artifact: vercel-mcp operation ledger (CAP-1, built by AUD-BE)

gaps.reason: No repo source or snapshot field records per-operation permissions, roles or entitlements; CAP-1's field is carried as an explicit unknown until a sourced entitlement table exists.
Per-operation owner units live only in prose batch dossiers; docs/TOOL-CATALOG.md sections are functional families, not units, so no machine-readable mapping exists to generate from.
Request shapes are validated against the pinned snapshot (tests.requestShape), but no per-operation response-test record exists in the repo.
Live acceptance is CAP-5's track by design; this ledger pins source evidence only and claims no live parity.
The snapshot's bearerToken scheme does not distinguish personal, team-scoped and integration-installation tokens.
Resource-specific credentials (Blob store read-write tokens, Global Config tokens, Gateway keys) are not snapshot security schemes; the SDK rows, whose route is the store token, record documented.
